summary_en: 700,000 shares (2.14% of shares outstanding), ¥15.0B ceiling, open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange, Aug 10–Nov 30, 2026. Purpose: capital-efficiency improvement and shareholder return.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Hirose Electric Co., Ltd. announced on 4 August 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire treasury shares under Article 165(3) of the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation. The program authorizes acquisition of up to 700,000 shares (2.14% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum total of ¥15.0 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition window runs from 10 August 2026 through 30 November 2026. The stated purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns as part of the company's capital allocation policy. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 1,808,925 treasury shares against 32,721,510 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
